name: com.venoh/ai-visibility
title: Venoh AI Visibility
description: Free check: when buyers ask AI for the best option, is your business named, or a rival?

tools.name: check_ai_visibility
tools.description: Free check: asks Perplexity 5 questions a buyer would ask about the company's category and city, and shows whether the company is named and who is named instead. Once per email, and each website once a week. Takes about a minute.

website.description: The company's website, for example acme.in

email.description: Work email of the person asking (one free check per email)

market.description: City or country the buyers are in, for example Pune or India. Defaults to India.

company.description: Company name, if the homepage title isn't it

category.description: What the company sells in 2 to 4 words, for example dental clinic. Read from the homepage when left out.

tools.name: find_buyer_questions
tools.description: Lists the plain questions buyers ask AI assistants when looking for a provider in a category and city.

category.description: What the business sells, for example CA firm or CRM software

market.description: City or country, for example Mumbai or India. Defaults to India.

tools.name: get_venoh_plans
tools.description: Venoh's plans and monthly prices in rupees and dollars.
